summary.source_video_count_label: Distinct source video IDs; not a count of people.
summary.detector_success_rule: OpenFace success == 1, regardless of confidence; valid_face_frames additionally requires confidence >= 0.8.

pilot_sample.transcript: I think social justice is extremely important for young people.
pilot_sample.label_note: Dataset-provided label, not a model prediction.
pilot_sample.boundary_note: Word timing is an automatic CTC alignment estimate; the user confirmed transcript content and overall pause/order/speaking-rate consistency by listening, but did not manually verify each exact boundary.
pilot_sample.text_embedding_note: 768 BERT embedding coordinates per word; the archive has no human-readable name for each embedding dimension.

audio_loudness.sampling: 200 uniformly spaced source windows selected from the 419-row eGeMAPS LLD output; no smoothing or interpolation.

x_axis.name: time
x_axis.definition: midpoint of each source analysis window

y_axis.name: openSMILE Loudness_sma3
y_axis.definition: Frame-level perceptual loudness descriptor; not decibels (dB) and not a calibrated sound-pressure measurement.

facial_action_unit_12.sampling: All 128 decoded video-frame estimates; original frame-level values, no downsampling.

x_axis.name: time
x_axis.definition: OpenFace frame timestamp from video start

y_axis.name: AU12_r
y_axis.unit: OpenFace action-unit intensity estimate scale (not a physical unit)
y_axis.definition: Estimated intensity for Facial Action Unit 12, lip-corner puller; model estimate, not a direct measurement of emotion.

provenance.data_definition: The 100 sample rows are clips from 37 distinct source video IDs. Source video ID is not a person count.
provenance.quality_rule: A valid visual frame has OpenFace success == 1 and confidence >= 0.8. A sample with at least 80% valid frames is coverage_at_least_80_percent; a nonzero lower rate is partial coverage; zero valid frames is no valid face frames.
provenance.transcript_rule: Only the pilot transcript is included, after user listening confirmation. Dataset transcripts/labels were not changed. One of 100 original transcript records remains marked transcript_review_needed.
provenance.feature_provenance: Pilot features are locally extracted features and must not be described as the benchmark attachment feature arrays.
